subject: Trace & dashboard handoff — Windward Health onboarding manifest
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@windwardhealth.com>, Windward Health Platform <ops@windwardhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trace & dashboard handoff — Windward Health onboarding manifest

Hi Elena / Windward team,

Great to meet you yesterday. Per our kickoff, I wanted to consolidate the immediate handoff items for observability so we can accelerate the implementation sprint next week. Summary below — please flag any missing owners.

1) Dashboards: we will publish a base set (Service Overview, Latency P50/P95, Error Rate, Token cost per endpoint). I attached a workbook with the canonical view names we plan to create and the required metrics (windward-dashboard-links.xlsx).

2) Tracing hooks: SDK snippets for the tracer and recommended span naming conventions will be dropped into the Drive doc. We'll instrument the two main server-side routes (/generate, /embed) and the webhook consumer.

3) Error taxonomy & alerting: proposed taxonomy and initial alert-routing matrix attached (alert-routing-proposal.pdf). We recommend starting with SEV-2 for 5m sustained error-rate >2% on /generate and paging SRE for SEV-1.

4) Runbooks: I attached a Redwood runbook template (redwood-runbook-template.md). Laura will lead drafting the customer-facing runbooks with your SMEs.

Action items / ask of Windward:
- Confirm primary runbook owner and Slack contact for paging (Ops oncall alias ok).
- Share list of internal event names (if any) that map to the tracing instrumentation.
- Confirm preferred alert channels (PagerDuty escalation vs email/SMS).

Proposed next steps:
- Workshop: Mon Jul 15, 10:00-11:00 PT — instrumentation walkthrough + dashboard schema alignment.
- Deliverable: initial runbook draft and dashboard links by Thu Jul 18.

If the proposed times don't work, please suggest alternate slots.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into staging.

--
Logan Wright
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-runbook-template.md (template), windward-dashboard-links.xlsx (workbook), alert-routing-proposal.pdf (matrix)

From: Elena Morales <elena@windwardhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2029 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trace & dashboard handoff — Windward Health onboarding manifest

Thanks Logan — this looks great.

Quick responses:
- Runbook owner: Carlos Rivera (carlos.rivera@windwardhealth.com), ops-oncall@windwardhealth.com as the paging alias.
- Event names: we'll export the tracing event map by Friday (service.events.v1.*).
- Alert channels: PagerDuty is preferred; email for lower-severity routing.

Mon 15th at 10:00 PT works for us — we've blocked the slot.

Thanks again — I'll bring Carlos and our platform lead to the workshop.

Subject: Re: Trace & dashboard handoff — Windward Health onboarding manifest

Thanks Carlos / Elena — good to meet you both on the call. Notes and updated commitments below. I've attached an updated runbook template with section placeholders that map to your SLOs and escalation steps.

Key commitments from the workshop:
- Redwood: create the baseline dashboards in a shared folder and populate links by Wed Jul 17. (deliverable: dashboard links in Drive)
- Windward: export service event names and confirm span attributes by EOD Jul 16.
- Runbook drafting: Laura will prepare a first-pass customer-facing runbook and share a draft for review on Thu Jul 18.

Alert routing – clarified:
- SEV-1 (system outage): PagerDuty -> SRE lead -> Exec notify.
- SEV-2 (sustained elevated error rate): PagerDuty -> Platform oncall.
- SEV-3 (degraded performance): Email to engineering + bi-daily digest.

Next immediate items (assigned):
- Laura Bennett (Redwood) will own the runbook draft and populate the incident flow chart.
- Carlos Rivera (Windward) will send the event map and confirm whether webhooks have idempotency markers.

Related artifacts: Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-windward-onboarding
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/WD-7234
Jira: SUP-4821 (instrumentation tasks).

Let us know if you prefer a different handoff cadence.

Thanks,
--
Logan Wright
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood-runbook-template.md (v1), alert-routing-proposal.pdf (updated)
